Batch scrape with empty batch_urls array returns error

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::batch_scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let result = batch_scrape(&engine, urls).await;
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
